pages.text: Forged from the fragments of a Luxtructosaurus, this battleaxe carries the power of extinction. Every strike sets creatures ablaze and accumulates destructive force. Once the axe's power reaches its limit, sneak and right-click to release a devastating impact even more destructive than its normal strike.
This battleaxe has infinite durability and cannot be destroyed by fire or explosions. When used to break logs while not sneaking, it automatically chain-breaks connected logs of the same type.
